we propose a framework and a reinforcement learning algorithm that enables a dialog system to seamlessly transition between task and non- task content.

developing a framework to interweave nontask content into task-oriented conversations to improve user engagement and task success rate.
the development of a new generation of conversational agents that can handle both task and social content.
developing a dialog system that can have smooth transitions from task to non-task content and vice versa.
